label: daemon event loop wedge: synchronous git worktree add (distinct from the rerank spawn storm) evidence
title: daemon event loop wedge: synchronous git worktree add (distinct from the rerank spawn storm) evidence
summary: A SECOND, distinct root cause of the daemon "wedge" (GET /health times out, calls hang past socket timeout), complementary to the rerank spawn storm in [[note-mqqv4ix36dd]] (which is owned + already fixed under task 5 and is NOT re-fixed here). This vector: lib/git.js ran every git command via execFileSync on the daemon's single event-loop thread, so a worktree op froze ALL requests (including /health) for its whole duration. Measured on a 124-worktree repo: git worktree add ~5.5s, worktree remove ~2s, git status ~0.15s. An in-process event-loop probe showed 6.5-7.4s stalls 1:1 with each subconscious assignment prepare call (its createWorktree); the bench that reported the wedge (_fair_agentic_v2.py) interleaves a prepare before every search-context call, and its 3s /health timeout is shorter than the 5.5s git block, so it read the daemon as wedged. This path (prepare / branch_task / merge_attempt / merge_feature / automode judge-merge) hits the synchronous git on EVERY task dispatch, so it is a real production exposure under concurrent agents. Reproduced both vectors together: pure search-context (no prepare) stayed responsive on this 8-core/68GB box (the rerank storm only added ~
